title:
Free
the Memes
description: Un remake mémesque de Shadow Hunters : identités cachées, bagarres dans une chambre de mamie et équipements absurdes. Users, Memers ou Trollers, à toi de deviner qui est qui.
css: .ribbon { margin: -3px 3rem 0 -3px; padding: .35rem 1.5rem .35rem .9rem; background: var(--red); font: italic 400 1rem/1.2 Anton, Impact, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 16px) 100%, 0 100%); }

h2 { margin: 0; font: italic 400 clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 3.4rem)/.95 Anton, Impact, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--red); transform: rotate(-2deg); transform-origin: left; }

.die { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.6rem; height: 3.2rem; background: #012456; color: rgb(255, 228, 77); font: 300 2.2rem/1 "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; border-left: 2px solid rgb(255, 228, 77); border-right: 2px solid rgb(255, 228, 77); }
.tags span { padding: 0 .55rem; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; font-size: .85rem; transform: skewX(-8deg); }

.go { padding: .5rem 1.3rem; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border: 2px solid var(--paper); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--red); transform: skewX(-8deg); font: italic 400 1.1rem Anton, Impact, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
